operation.body:
## Goal
Complete readiness-safe bootstrap for Mac Thermal Control after the recorded S-001 and definition approvals, preparing one documentation-only PR before product implementation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Assess the canonical bootstrap checklist against current main and record evidence and remaining gates in project requirements.
- Customize repository identity and project-owned architecture guidance for the approved Swift/Foundation stack with a minimal reviewed C boundary. Mark reusable stack guidance not-applicable where no matching profile exists; preserve private workflow sources.
- Explicitly defer unavailable application setup/run/test/lint/typecheck/build commands, exact toolchain/SDK selection and product CI to the first scaffold-producing discovery goal; do not invent commands or add placeholder packaging.
- Document existing adapter validation/CI separately from product and target-device validation, human review/merge, local manual execution, rollback and release boundaries. Keep project context and README consistent.
- Validate documentation links, bootstrap markers, whitespace and workflow leakage; run applicable adapter checks and remote CI. Report readiness honestly, including human bootstrap review before product work.

## Constraints
Parent: https://github.com/szymoniwacz/mac-thermal-control/issues/1. Authorized by the owner's current local execute-project invocation with self-correcting-review, without auto-merge. Human review and merge remain required by project scope and bootstrap review gates. One delegated goal only.
Documentation/readiness only. No product scaffold, dependency installation, hardware commands or capture, privilege elevation, workloads, SMC writes, controller changes or background automation. Preserve private workflow, historical observations, existing CI coverage and unrelated .gitlab/ files. All operation-specific safety approvals remain separate. S-001/definition are approved; R-001 and later phase choices remain gated. Risks: confusing adapter checks with product compatibility; premature readiness claims; leaking private workflow. Decision queue: no new material choice needed for documentation; stop if readiness needs one.

## Out of scope
Product behavior, toolchain installation, detailed discovery schema/source adoption, CI redesign, control/GUI architecture selection, hardware validation, a second goal, merge.

## Relevant context
.ai/onboarding/bootstrap-checklist.md; .ai/onboarding/template-customization-guide.md; .ai/docs/project-requirements.md; .ai/project/; docs/monterey-telemetry-research.md; docs/historical-reference-2026-11-13.md. S-001/definition approval: https://github.com/szymoniwacz/mac-thermal-control/issues/1#issuecomment-6863771976.
